tweaks.name: Game Mode on
tweaks.hint: Keeps Windows Game Mode on: it deprioritizes background work and holds off Windows Update installs while you play.
tweaks.description: Sets AutoGameModeEnabled to 1 (the Windows default). Game Mode gives the foreground game priority for CPU and GPU resources, suppresses Windows Update driver installs and restart notifications during play. Some tweak guides turn it off; Microsoft recommends leaving it on.

tweaks.name: Background recording (Game DVR capture) off
tweaks.hint: Turns off Xbox Game Bar capture and 'Record what happened' so the GPU encoder and disk stay free. Game Bar stays installed.
tweaks.description: Turns off Game DVR capture for your account (GameDVR_Enabled, AppCaptureEnabled and HistoricalCaptureEnabled = 0). Background recording keeps a rolling video buffer that uses the GPU video encoder, memory and disk writes during play. Game Bar, its overlay and controller features stay installed. Use NVIDIA or Steam recording if you want clips.

evidence.notes: Microsoft documents Game DVR capture and the AllowGameDVR policy; iG Windows Tuner changes the per-user Settings values and reports the machine policy if one is set.

tweaks.name: Optimizations for windowed games
tweaks.hint: Moves DX10/11 borderless and windowed games to the flip presentation model for lower latency. Merges into existing settings.
tweaks.description: Adds SwapEffectUpgradeEnable=1 to DirectXUserGlobalSettings (Settings > System > Display > Graphics). DirectX 10/11 games in windowed or borderless mode move from blt-model to flip-model presentation, which lowers frame latency and enables VRR and Auto HDR. Only this item is changed; other items in the string are preserved. Per-app overrides you set in Settings still win.

evidence.notes: If Auto HDR is on, Windows keeps this on as well.

tweaks.name: Optimizations for variable refresh rate
tweaks.hint: Lets DX11 games that lack native VRR support use G-SYNC/FreeSync. Merges into existing settings.
tweaks.description: Adds VRROptimizeEnable=1 to DirectXUserGlobalSettings. On VRR-capable displays, Windows applies variable refresh rate to DirectX 11 games that do not support it natively, reducing tearing and stutter. Only this item is changed; other items are preserved.

evidence.notes: Has no effect on displays without VRR.

tweaks.name: Hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling
tweaks.hint: Lets the GPU schedule its own work. Results on RTX 30-series vary by game: measure frametimes before/after. Reboot.
tweaks.description: Sets HwSchMode to 2. With HAGS the GPU's scheduling processor manages its own work queue, which can reduce CPU overhead and latency slightly. On RTX 30-series the effect ranges from a small gain to a small loss depending on the game and driver. Measure 1% lows before and after; revert if worse.

evidence.notes: Requires a WDDM 2.7+ driver. Absent value means the driver default.

tweaks.name: Per-game GPU preference: High performance
tweaks.hint: Pins detected games to the high-performance GPU. Matters only when the iGPU is enabled. Measure before/after.
tweaks.description: Writes GpuPreference=2 for each detected game executable under UserGpuPreferences, the same value Settings > System > Display > Graphics writes. With an enabled iGPU (UHD 770), Windows could otherwise pick the wrong adapter. Existing per-app items (such as SwapEffectUpgradeEnable) are preserved. Not applicable when only one GPU is active.

evidence.notes: Situational: only relevant on systems with more than one active GPU.

tweaks.name: GPU message-signaled interrupts (MSI)
tweaks.hint: EXPERT: switches the GPU to MSI where its driver declares support. Many GPUs already use MSI. Reboot; measure DPC latency.
tweaks.description: Sets MSISupported = 1 under the GPU's Interrupt Management key, but only when its driver declares MSI support. Message-signaled interrupts avoid shared interrupt lines and can lower interrupt latency; most current GPUs already use them, and the interrupt inspector shows the mode in use. Measure DPC latency (LatencyMon) before and after. If the display misbehaves after the reboot, revert from Backups & Logs.
tweaks.warning: Changes how the graphics card signals interrupts. Takes effect after a reboot. If the screen stays black or flickers after the reboot, start in Safe Mode or use another display output and revert this item.

evidence.notes: Applied only to Display devices whose driver created MessageSignaledInterruptProperties.
